body:
Assuming this is accurate:
```suggestion
			If [code]true[/code], the alpha on the decal's [member texture_albedo] will replace the surface's alpha onto any pixel where the decal's alpha is greater. This results in the decal appearing more or equally as opaque as the surface.
```
Or similar. It's a bit tricky. It could also use a slightly more elaborate use-case, albeit this is the expected behaviour of decals for most.

"Override" is more appropriate in this case than "overwrite".

```suggestion
			If [code]true[/code], the alpha from the decal's [member texture_albedo] will override the surface's alpha for any pixel where the decal's alpha is greater. This ensures that the resulting pixels are at least as opaque as the decal, never less.
```
